page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. The instance features 40 physical cores with 40 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.8 GB of RAM per core, and lacks local storage or GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates average performance across multiple categories. The dedicated Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 2133.36 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 108.89 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.09 GB/sec. For computational tasks, the server registers a Geekbench multi-core score of 12045.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 34691.95.

The lack of local storage and GPU hardware represents a clear tradeoff, requiring external storage attachments for persistent data and limiting its utility for heavy graphics or large-scale deep learning training. However, the dedicated core allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio provide stable resource density. This makes the instance qualitatively cost-effective for workloads requiring predictable CPU execution without the premium of GPU hardware.

The ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is suited for workloads such as static web serving, which registers a throughput of 25.35 GB/sec, and database operations, supported by a Passmark database score of 14249.04 and 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second. It is also capable of handling software compilation, text processing, and small to medium scale language model inference, achieving 12.71 tokens per second for text generation on a 7B model.
